scope: 80 public HTML files, 5 languages; official-policy review, implementation, local Chrome verification; deployment verification recorded separately
interpretation: The AdSense low-value-content notice does not identify a particular offending page. Findings below are observed site issues, not confirmed rejection causes. Approval is not guaranteed.
